newsitem.title: USA: Liberty Property says closes credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Liberty Property says closes credit facility.

text.p: Liberty Property Trust said Wednesday it closed a $325 million unsecured revolving credit facility arranged by BankBoston NA.
The initial interest rate is LIBOR plus 125 basis points, subject to adjustment based on the company's level of leverage and its credit rating.
At a BBB-/Baa3 rating, the interest rate on the new facility would be LIBOR plus 110 basis points.
Liberty said the new facility replaces the its existing $250 million and $100 million secured facilities.

The interest rates on these facilities were LIBOR plus 175 basis points and LIBOR plus 160 basis points, respectively. The new revolving credit facility matures in 1999 and can be extended for one year.
Liberty said the replacement of the secured facilities with an unsecured facility results in the release of liens on properties with operating income of about $55 million.
Liberty Property Trust is a real estate investment trust.
